name: Alibaba Cloud ACK (Harbor backend)

modes.label: ACK cluster runtime
modes.note: Pods on ECS worker nodes: price = ECS node rates (see alibaba-ecs card) for whole nodes; ACK requires worker nodes of at least 4 vCPU / 8 GB. ACK itself adds the Pro cluster fee.

modes.label: ACK pods on virtual nodes (ECI), per vCPU/GiB
modes.note: ECI list rate (docs give no region; 'Prices displayed on the purchase page and in bills take precedence'). Billed from Pending (image pull) to Succeeded/Failed on requested, not used, resources. Economy vCPU $0.015264/h. 30 GiB temp storage free per pod, extra ~$0.000000093/GiB-s. ack-virtual-node component is free; cluster fee (Pro $0.09/h or Basic free) still applies. Regional ECI vCPU quota varies by account history.

plans.name: ACK managed Pro
plans.note: USD 0.09 per cluster per hour x 730 h. Per cluster, not per sandbox; billed every hour the cluster is Running/Upgrading/etc. even with zero pods; first and last partial hour free; 'Prices may vary by region'. Can be offset by a resource package. Workers (ECS/ECI), API-server CLB, NAT gateway, EIP, disks billed separately.

plans.name: ACK managed Basic
plans.note: No cluster management fee; max 10 nodes/cluster, 1,000 serverless pods/cluster, 2 clusters/account, not raisable; docs say 'For personal testing or learning only'. All cloud resources still billed.

caveats: Harbor ACK is customer-managed Alibaba Kubernetes, distinct from Alibaba AgentRun/FC sandbox. Platform and underlying worker node/storage/network billing must be combined.
Not fully priceable in ENGINE_CARD: unknown USD resource rates or machine shape. Null is not zero; do not rank as a free provider.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

fleet.verification: Identity verification required before creating a cluster.
fleet.tiers: Basic: 2 clusters/account, 10 nodes/cluster, 10 node pools, 1,000 serverless pods/cluster (not adjustable; 'for personal testing or learning only'). Pro: 100 clusters/account; nodes/cluster Flannel 200 default (1,000 max) or Terway 5,000 default (50,000 max); 50,000 serverless (ECI) pods/cluster; increases via Quota Center. Underlying ECS on-demand quota 500 vCPU, spot 800 vCPU (ticket).
fleet.notes: Cluster/node ceilings are not a new-account machine entitlement: backing ECS/ECI quotas, network quotas and stock still bind. Do not multiply cluster maxima into default instances. ECI create rate: CreateContainerGroup token bucket burst 100, refill 20/s (ticket to raise); ECI regional vCPU quota 'Varies by account based on historical usage' (Quota Center). The cluster fee, API-server CLB and NAT are paid per cluster.
